mapper.select: SELECT permission_id, permission_name, resource_pattern, http_method, status, description, created_time, updated_time FROM test.permissions ORDER BY permission_id

SELECT p.permission_id, p.permission_name, p.resource_pattern, p.http_method, p.status, p.description, p.created_time, p.updated_time FROM test.permissions p WHERE p.status = 'active' AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM test.relation_user_permissions up WHERE up.permission_id = p.permission_id AND up.user_id = #{userId} AND (up.tenant_id IS NULL OR up.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM test.relation_user_roles ur JOIN test.roles r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN test.relation_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id WHERE rp.permission_id = p.permission_id AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND (ur.tenant_id IS NULL OR ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND r.status = 'active' ) )
